sample_unit: patient information leaflets (3 models x 3 topics)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated patient leaflets across five readability metrics
links.effect: ChatGPT most readable; DeepSeek markedly more complex and less accessible; Gemini intermediate. Flesch Reading Ease differed significantly between models (H = 7.20, p = 0.027); other metrics approached significance.
links.quote: DeepSeek generated text that was markedly more complex and less accessible.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of AI-generated patient leaflets by model
links.effect: ChatGPT had the lowest grade-level indices and highest Flesch Reading Ease; DeepSeek was more complex; Gemini intermediate. Flesch Reading Ease differed significantly (H = 7.20, p = 0.027).
links.quote: ChatGPT consistently produced the most readable content, with the highest Flesch Reading Ease scores and the lowest grade-level indices.

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the baseline readability of dementia/delirium patient information leaflets generated by ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and Gemini using automated readability metrics.
